title: Queue independent acceptance evaluation from settled evidence instead of manual turn and slot handoffs
outcome: When an item's required evidence is ready, the host durably schedules its independent acceptance evaluation and resumes the requester with the result, without a manual next-turn request or per-evaluation coordinator placement message.
acceptance: A qualifying evidence settlement durably queues the item's required independent acceptance evaluation and resumes the requester on the recorded result, without a manual next-turn request or placement mailbox exchange
Independent evaluation, evidence basis, capacity limits and existing refusal authority remain unchanged; a capacity wait reports its reason and release condition
